# awscc_mediatailor_function (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::MediaTailor::Function



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `function_id` (String) The unique identifier for the function.
- `function_type` (String) The type of the function. Determines which configuration object is used.

### Optional

- `custom_output_configuration` (Attributes) Configuration for custom output functions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_output_configuration))
- `description` (String) A description of the function.
- `http_request_configuration` (Attributes) Configuration for HTTP request functions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--http_request_configuration))
- `sequential_executor_configuration` (Attributes) Configuration for sequential executor functions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequential_executor_configuration))
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags to assign to the function resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the function.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--custom_output_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_output_configuration`

Optional:

- `output` (Map of String) A map of output key-value pairs that define the custom output.
- `runtime` (String) The runtime environment for the function expression language.


<a id="nestedatt--http_request_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `http_request_configuration`

Optional:

- `body` (String) The body of the HTTP request.
- `headers` (Map of String) A map of HTTP headers to include in the request.
- `method_type` (String) The HTTP method type for the request.
- `output` (Map of String) A map of output key-value pairs. Keys must start with session., temp., avail., scte., or be a valid adsRequest directive.
- `request_timeout_milliseconds` (Number) The timeout in milliseconds for the HTTP request. Maximum value is 2000.
- `runtime` (String) The runtime environment for the function expression language.
- `url` (String) The URL endpoint for the HTTP request.


<a id="nestedatt--sequential_executor_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sequential_executor_configuration`

Optional:

- `function_list` (Attributes List) The list of functions to execute sequentially. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sequential_executor_configuration--function_list))
- `output` (Map of String) A map of output key-value pairs that define the final output from sequential execution.
- `runtime` (String) The runtime environment for the function expression language.
- `timeout_milliseconds` (Number) The timeout in milliseconds for the entire sequential execution chain.

<a id="nestedatt--sequential_executor_configuration--function_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sequential_executor_configuration.function_list`

Optional:

- `run_condition` (String) A conditional expression that determines whether this function should execute.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_mediatailor_function.example
  identity = {
    function_id = "function_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `function_id` (String) The unique identifier for the function

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_mediatailor_function.example
  id = "function_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_mediatailor_function.example "function_id"
```
